question: What proportion of the total length is assigned to the four-cornered section when divided into twelve parts?
premises: The total length is divided into twelve parts.
A portion of this length is allocated.
Seven parts form the four-cornered section.
inference: When the length is divided into twelve parts, seven parts constitute the four-cornered section.
plain_english: When that length is divided into twelve parts, seven parts form the four-cornered section.
